name: ODSOColumn
description: Represents a field in a data source. The ODSOColumn object is a member of the ODSOColumns collection.
remarks: The ODSOColumns collection includes all the data fields in a mail merge data source (for example, Name, Address, and City). You cannot add fields to the ODSOColumns collection. All data fields in a data source are automatically included in the ODSOColumns collection. Use Columns(_index_), where _index_ is the data field name or index number, to return a single ODSOColumn object. The index number represents the position of the data field in the mail merge data source.
example:
Sub GetDataFromSource()

 Dim appOffice As OfficeDataSourceObject

 Set appOffice = Application.OfficeDataSourceObject
 appOffice.Open bstrConnect:="DRIVER=SQL Server;SERVER=ServerName;" & _
 "UID=user;PWD=;DATABASE=Northwind", bstrTable:="Employees"

 With appOffice.Columns
 MsgBox "Field Name: " & .Item(1).Name & vbLf & _
 "Value: " & .Item(1).Value
 End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ODSOColumn object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ODSOColumn object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Gets a Long representing the index number for an ODSOColumn object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of a data field in a mail merge data source. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ODSOColumn object. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Gets the value of a data field in a mail merge data source. Read-only.
